title: forgalmas, nyugodt, modern, kedvenc: Describing a Place

sections.title: Four words for character, not just location
sections.content: *forgalmas* ("busy, bustling"), *nyugodt* ("calm, peaceful"), and *modern* ("modern") describe what a place is like, the same way *csendes* and *hangos* already do. *kedvenc* ("favourite") goes in front of a noun — *kedvenc pékségem*, "my favourite bakery" — the way every other adjective you know does.

items.english: Our district is calm, not busy.

items.spanish: Van egy kedvenc pékségem a sarkon.
items.english: I have a favourite bakery on the corner.

sections.content: *modern* is a straight loanword, with no vowel-harmony surprises. To compare two places you can use *olyan... mint* from Unit 4.
